assessments.rejection_reason: Truncation cannot occur on any reachable path. Send is the only caller of Encode and rejects payloads above MaxPayload = 200, which is below the 256-byte wrap point, so byte(len(payload)) is always exact.

proposed_test.description: Call transport.Send with a 300-byte payload: it returns an error and Encode is never reached.
